name: komo
tagline: One search across Slack, Notion, files and screenshots at work.
problem: Work information is scattered across long chat threads, documents and buried images, which wastes time.
solution: A unified workspace that connects workplace apps and returns related documents, messages and media for a single query.
demo_moment: Team-described: search once and get the Slack thread, the Notion page and the screenshot together.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Grounded in a teammate's daily pain at a startup.

lessons: A complete, polished take on a common pain can place well under completeness-heavy criteria.
